examples.en: Ava is meeting trouble halfway by assuming that she has failed.
examples.zh: 艾娃在未知道結果前便認定自己不合格，實在是過早擔心。

examples.en: Daniel meets trouble halfway whenever he expects an angry reply.
examples.zh: 丹尼爾每次都預期會收到憤怒的回覆，經常過早擔心。

meaning.en: To worry about a possible problem before it happens, especially when there is not yet enough evidence that it will happen.
meaning.zh: 在問題尚未發生、證據仍然不足時，便預先擔心可能出現的麻煩；即杞人憂天、過早作最壞打算或自尋煩惱。
naturalZh: 在問題尚未發生、證據仍然不足時，便預先擔心可能出現的麻煩
即杞人憂天、過早作最壞打算或自尋煩惱。

register.summaryEn: This lesson treats the expression as neutral but traditional. It is most natural in advice, reassurance, reflective comments and mild criticism. It may sound slightly old-fashioned in very casual modern conversation, but it is not slang or rude. Historical records and present-day reference material both show the expression in advisory or proverbial use.
register.summaryZh: 本課把這個表達視為中性但較傳統的說法。 它最適合用於勸告、安慰、反思及溫和批評。 它在現代非常隨意的對話中可能略帶舊式色彩，但並不粗俗。
contextsEn: meet trouble half of the way
register.formalEn: Use the idiom only in the contexts described in the source.
register.formalZh: 只在原檔說明的合適情境中使用這個慣用語。

benefits.zh: 這個慣用語可以把「結果尚未公布，卻已經擔心最壞情況」濃縮成一個較簡潔的表達。

benefits.en: The expression reminds the listener that a feared conclusion has not yet been proved.
benefits.zh: 這個表達提醒聽者，他所害怕的結論仍然未有證據證實。
這種說法有時比直接說「你擔心得太多」更溫和。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful for Reflective Comments
benefits.en: The expression helps speakers look back and recognise that their earlier fear was unnecessary.
benefits.zh: 這個表達有助說話者回顧事情，承認自己先前的恐懼並沒有必要。

benefits.titleEn: It Adds Variety When the Situation Genuinely Fits
benefits.titleZh: 在合適語境中增加表達變化
benefits.en: Plain expressions such as worry too soon or assume the worst are often clearer in everyday speech. Meet trouble halfway provides another option when the speaker wishes to use a more traditional or figurative expression.
benefits.zh: 或 assume the worst 在日常英語中往往更加直接。 只有在語境合適時，才應使用 meet trouble halfway 作為較傳統和具比喻色彩的說法。

origin.statusEn: Exact Origin Unknown; Long-Established Metaphorical Saying
origin.statusZh: 確切來源不明；歷史悠久的比喻說法

history.en: The exact first use has not been identified. One early record located for this worksheet is an 1890 American newspaper heading, “Meeting Trouble Half Way”. A 1911 newspaper later printed the advice “Do not meet trouble half-way” beside the contrasting saying “Prepare for a rainy day”. An Irish folklore collection also recorded “Never meet trouble half-way” as an old saying. These records show that the figurative idea was established by the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, but they do not identify its inventor or exact starting point. Today, the expression advises people not to create unnecessary anxiety by assuming that a possible problem has already become real.
history.zh: 這個表達的確切首次用法尚未能確認。 本教材找到的一項較早記錄，是一份1890年的美國報章以 Meeting Trouble Half Way 作為標題。 1911年的另一份報章把 Do not meet trouble half-way 與 Prepare for a rainy day 並列。 愛爾蘭民俗資料庫亦把 Never meet trouble half-way 記錄為一句古老說法。 這些資料顯示，這個比喻在十九世紀末至二十世紀初已經有人使用，但並不能證明由誰創造，亦無法確定它首次出現的時間。 今天，這個表達用來勸告別人不要把尚未確定的問題當成已經發生，以免產生不必要的焦慮。

origin.memoryEn: Do not walk towards trouble before you know that it is really coming.
origin.memoryZh: 在確定麻煩真的會來之前，不要先走上前迎接它。

rules.titleEn: The Trouble Must Still Be Uncertain
rules.titleZh: 規則一：麻煩必須仍未確定
rules.en: The expression is used when somebody is worrying before enough facts are available. The problem is now confirmed, so the expression is no longer the best description.
rules.zh: 只有當某人在事實尚未清楚前已開始擔心，才適合使用這個表達。 老師尚未批改我的功課，我卻已經認定自己不合格，實在是過早擔心。 老師已經告訴我不合格。 問題已經得到確認，因此這個慣用語不再是最合適的描述。

examples.zh: 老師尚未批改我的功課，我卻已經認定自己不合格，實在是過早擔心。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Sensible Preparation
rules.titleZh: 規則二：不要用來形容合理準備
rules.en: A serious storm warning has been issued, so the school has moved the event indoors. This is sensible preparation based on evidence.
rules.zh: 政府已發出嚴重暴風警告，因此學校把活動移到室內。 這是根據實際證據作出的合理安排。

rules.titleZh: 規則三：清楚指出當事人害怕甚麼結果
rules.en: The second sentence explains the exact unsupported conclusion.
rules.zh: 第二句清楚指出本在沒有回覆前，已認定請假申請遭到拒絕。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse Two Different Expressions
rules.titleZh: 規則五：不要混淆兩個不同表達
rules.en: = worry before trouble actually arrives = compromise or make an effort to reach agreement
rules.zh: 在麻煩真正出現前便預先擔心與某人互相讓步或作出妥協

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Every Future Concern
rules.titleZh: 規則六：並非所有對未來的擔心都適用
rules.en: 1. the negative outcome has not been confirmed; 2. the person is assuming more than the evidence shows; 3. the worry is arriving earlier than the actual problem.

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using meet trouble halfway.
instructions.zh: 使用 meet trouble halfway 改寫句子或完成回應。
